tasks.title: Recall multiple details
tasks.prompt:
Read the passage and answer only from it.

---
The library opens at 9 AM on weekdays. On Saturdays it opens at 10 AM and closes at 4 PM. On Sundays it is closed.
---

Answer: (1) What time does the library open on weekdays? (2) What time does it close on Saturdays? (3) Is the library open on Sundays?

tasks.title: Recall date and event
tasks.prompt:

---

---

tasks.title: Recall details from news
tasks.prompt:
Read the passage and answer only from it.

---
The city council meeting on June 10, 2026 lasted two hours. Council member Jane Doe presented the budget proposal. The proposal included a $500,000 grant for the park renovation.
---

Answer: (1) On what date did the city council meeting occur? (2) Who presented the budget proposal? (3) What was the amount of the grant for park renovation?
